damage.note: a unit pressed on the environment or another unit above part_force_N for `ticks` consecutive control ticks is a safety violation (the normal forces summed per unit and body it presses on; the gripper's pads on a unit do not count)

layout.note: the episode's physical draws: the work stand within jitter_m of its nominal place and turned by up to jitter_yaw_deg, the chassis on it within clamp_repeat_m and clamp_repeat_deg of its drawn place; the deck shelf and the parts tray around their nominal places in the same way, the deck and the tray's two units inside the play of their fixtures; every wheel and the stick pack moved by up to xy_m and turned about the vertical by up to yaw_deg around its place in the shop's layout of the kit, on the face that layout gives it, the stick pack's lead end either way; every hub turned from the drawn model's angle by an angle drawn uniformly over the hex's pitch

note: the cell's configuration as far as it is public (the camera mounts, what is drawn for the cameras and the shop's layout of the kit are not)

safety.note: robot_force_N: a robot link other than the gripper's pads pressing harder than this is a safety violation (see scoring.safety_violation_factor); part_speed_m_s: a loose unit faster than this, or off the bench, is scrapped (it no longer counts; the episode goes on)

scope.note: premounted: places the cell fastens itself before the episode starts; none in this version

scoring.note: count_subassembly true: a compute module or a LiDAR fastened on the deck assembly counts wherever the deck assembly is, unless the deck assembly is scrapped. safety_violation_factor: a safety violation (safety.robot_force_N, or damage.part_force_N for damage.ticks) does not end the episode, but an episode with one keeps only this share of its score, however many violations it has
